tagline: With Luck comes Trust, and then Hot Springs.
intro: NC 209 leaves I-40 at Exit 24 near Lake Junaluska and works north through Haywood County, past Fines Creek, to Betsy's Gap, with Hebo Mountain to the south and Pug Knob to the north. From the gap Spring Creek does the steering, and the road follows it down through Luck and Trust to Hot Springs on the French Broad. US 25/70 runs on from there to Walnut.

Local folklore says Fines Creek is named for a man killed in a skirmish in the late 1700s. With no time to dig a grave in the snow, his brother slid the body into the river through a hole in the ice, meaning to come back for it. The current got there first.

moments.title: Trust
moments.text: As the locals say, with Luck comes Trust, a mile or so on, where St. Jude's Chapel of Hope was built by a local woman after she beat a terminal illness.

moments.title: Hot Springs
moments.text: Drovers stopped at the only hot spring known in North Carolina, 108 degrees where Spring Creek meets the French Broad, and the Appalachian Trail now runs down Bridge Street.
